raw_segments.text: Between the 33rd and 37th degrees of north latitude, a vast tract of country lies, which
has taken the name of Arkansas from the principal river that waters its extent.
It is bounded on the one side by the confines of Mexico, on the other by the Mississippi.
Numberless streams cross it in every direction.
